The project team demonstrates through each Application how Scikit-learn can be used to build predictive models that improve decision-making processes in water management. 4.2 Getting Started with Python 4.2.1 Online Notebooks vs. Device Installs To facilitate the learning process, the project team provides users with options for setting up their Python environment: Online Notebooks: • Google Colab: A free cloud service from Google that supports coding with Python. It allows users to write and execute code in their browser, making it easy to get started without installing anything on their computer. It also provides free access to GPUs, which can speed up AI experiments, and integration with the commonly used Google Workspace. The project team encourages users to start with Google Colab due to its ease of use and accessibility. • Jupyter Notebooks: An open-source web application that allows users to create and share documents that contain live code, equations, visualizations, and narrative text. Users can use Jupyter Notebooks locally, requiring installation, or in the cloud. The project team shows how Jupyter Notebooks can be used for developing and sharing reproducible data analysis workflows.
